column1: # Phase 10 -- utils/: the tools that measure the agent. Applied repo-wide.
# NOT in this map, on purpose:
#     argparse derives `args.partidas` from the flag `--partidas`, and the flags
#     stay in Spanish, so those attributes cannot move.
#   * `total_seconds`, which is a stdlib method, not our name.
#   * module names (`bot_rival`, `log_replay`, ...), which wave with the file
# Most of the literals above are DATA: keys of the autopsy JSON, of the corpus
# snapshot and of the fixtures, so they carry `code` -- the identifier moves,
# the key does not. The exception is `nombres_mutables`, which the architecture
# test patches BY NAME, so it carries `str` and its literal moves too.
# `mazo` and `pasos` are NOT here: each collides with an English name that
# already lives in the same scope, so they get a per-file target in map 15b
# `util -> useful` was tried and REVERTED: it also renamed `importlib.util`,
# a stdlib attribute. The renamer moves any attribute spelled like a mapped
# name, and it cannot tell whose object it belongs to -- so short words that
# exist in the standard library stay out of the map.
